verdict.rationale: The Go SDK documents SetRegistrarLockWithContext to lock or unlock a domain at the registrar, so a programmatic transfer lock exists. The RDAP record for namecheap.com shows server-side transfer, update and delete prohibitions, but that is Namecheap's own domain, not evidence of a registry-lock option offered to customers. missing for 10: evidence that transfer lock is on by default, a documented customer-facing registry-lock offering, independent or hands-on corroboration.
